webhooks.detail: Resource subscriptions API (PUT to subscribe, DELETE by id, list) for sale, refund, dispute, cancellation and subscription events. Also 'Ping' endpoint set in Gumroad settings with a test-ping button.

evidence.quote: Resource subscriptions allow you to receive webhook notifications when specific events occur in your Gumroad account.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox or test mode found in docs. Gumroad accounts are free to create, so a free account can test the API, and a test ping exists for webhooks. No dedicated sandbox documented.

rate_limits.summary: not documented; no numeric limits published (429 on exceed, per third-party mirror)

evidence.quote: Gumroad does not publish an OpenAPI specification.
Gumroad does not publish an OpenAPI specification.
